describe: The image shows a seamless grey stone surface with a wide raised pale border forming a large rectangle on the right, and a narrow recessed panel on the left containing dark carved glyphs. Thin dark cracks run through the lower part of the rectangle, and fine scratches cover the stone. Colours are light grey, mid grey and charcoal, with even lighting and moderate contrast. The raised border, the carved panel and the cracks must stay exactly in place.
